scope: Pure MAPPO fine-tuning with per-episode randomized starts, mixed particle densities and shared faster in-vitro flow
authorization: User requested original distributed point-like clots and more dynamic obstacles; earlier correct-first-then-train and visualization authorization persists
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
task: Original-scale MCA, four discrete clot targets, random distinct-branch robot starts, 32 advected moving spheres with contact penalty
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro point-target simulation. Radius 0.12 mm reaction regions; Gaussian flow-resistance smoothing is not a reaction zone or clot volume. No hardware/clinical claim.
reporting: Independent deterministic policy evaluations; diagnostic oracle success never reported as RL success
initialization_sampling: Each episode: shuffled navigable branches without replacement; length-weighted edge, radial offset <=65% of clearance; reject overlaps and invalid lumen projections. No clot-target bias.
entropy_estimator: Reparameterized current-policy tanh entropy; replaces incorrect cross-entropy on rollout actions
comparability: Compatible mca_point_36_v3 actor/critic warm-start from each matching EXP27 seed; optimizer, environment, RNG, step counters and evaluations start fresh. Parent scores excluded.
dashboard_message: EXP28：每回合随机机器人位置、三种障碍物疏密分布及15–25μL/min体外参考流量；继承EXP27策略权重继续纯强化学习，新环境成绩单独评估。
